subject: Capability Fabric hardened workbench

claims.claim: The desktop workbench rendered the exact three-recipe catalog and request/build surfaces.
Planning an unreviewed request visibly produced HELD with AUTHORITY_HOLD.
Checking explicit review and building visibly produced exactly one detached candidate with 12 files and no install or CANON claim.
At 390 by 844 CSS pixels, all three recipe title/family pairs were separated and the page had no horizontal overflow.

observationSeam: An initial semantic locator expected the result region to rename itself and timed out; a fresh DOM snapshot showed the product action had succeeded, and direct visual evidence then closed the product claim.
